```{ojs}
//| label: export-csv
export_trigger = {
  window._downloadCSV = () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById("download-btn");
    if (btn) { btn.classList.add("loading"); btn.querySelector(".btn-spinner").style.display = "block"; }
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      // Collect data
      const formatRow = (d, split) => {
        return `${d.id},${d.group},${d.original_class},${d.class},${d.X_s_prime.toFixed(4)},${d.X_y_prime.toFixed(4)},${split}`;
      };

      let csvLines = ["id,group,true_class,observed_class,x,y,split"];
      
      active_data.forEach(d => csvLines.push(formatRow(d, "Train")));
      val_pool.forEach(d => csvLines.push(formatRow(d, "Val")));
      test_pool.forEach(d => csvLines.push(formatRow(d, "Test")));

      const csvString = csvLines.join("\n");
      const blob = new Blob([csvString], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      
      const link = document.createElement("a");
      link.setAttribute("href", url);
      let filename = "bias_dataset_custom.csv";
      link.setAttribute("download", filename);
      link.style.visibility = 'hidden';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);

      if (btn) { btn.classList.remove("loading"); btn.querySelector(".btn-spinner").style.display = "none"; }
    }, 100);
  };
  return null;
}
```
```{ojs}
//| label: logistic-regression
lr_model = {
  // Simple Gradient Descent Logistic Regression
  const trainLR = (data, epochs=500, lr=0.5) => {
    let w0 = 0, w1 = 0, w2 = 0; // bias, X_s, X_y
    for (let e = 0; e < epochs; e++) {
      let g0 = 0, g1 = 0, g2 = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
        const d = data[i];
        const z = w0 + w1 * d.X_s_prime + w2 * d.X_y_prime;
        // prevent overflow
        const p = z > 20 ? 1 : (z < -20 ? 0 : 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-z)));
        const target = d.class === "Positive" ? 1 : 0;
        const err = p - target;
        g0 += err;
        g1 += err * d.X_s_prime;
        g2 += err * d.X_y_prime;
      }
      w0 -= (lr / data.length) * g0;
      w1 -= (lr / data.length) * g1;
      w2 -= (lr / data.length) * g2;
    }
    return {w0, w1, w2};
  };

  const weights = trainLR(active_data, 500, 0.5);
  return weights;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: metrics-evaluation
metrics = {
  const {w0, w1, w2} = lr_model;
  
  let stats = {
    Privileged: { TP: 0, FP: 0, TN: 0, FN: 0, pos_scores: [], neg_scores: [] },
    Disadvantaged: { TP: 0, FP: 0, TN: 0, FN: 0, pos_scores: [], neg_scores: [] }
  };
  
  test_pool.forEach(d => {
    const z = w0 + w1 * d.X_s_prime + w2 * d.X_y_prime;
    const pred = z > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    const prob = 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-z));
    const actual = d.original_class === "Positive" ? 1 : 0; 
    
    let g = stats[d.group];
    if (actual === 1) {
      g.pos_scores.push(prob);
      if (pred === 1) g.TP++; else g.FN++;
    } else {
      g.neg_scores.push(prob);
      if (pred === 1) g.FP++; else g.TN++;
    }
  });

  const calcGroupMetrics = (g) => {
    const TPR = (g.TP + g.FN) > 0 ? g.TP / (g.TP + g.FN) : 0;
    const FPR = (g.FP + g.TN) > 0 ? g.FP / (g.FP + g.TN) : 0;
    const TNR = (g.FP + g.TN) > 0 ? g.TN / (g.FP + g.TN) : 0;
    const SR = (g.TP + g.FP + g.TN + g.FN) > 0 ? (g.TP + g.FP) / (g.TP + g.FP + g.TN + g.FN) : 0;
    const BalAcc = (TPR + TNR) / 2;
    
    // Quick AUC using Mann-Whitney U
    let u = 0;
    for (let p of g.pos_scores) {
      for (let n of g.neg_scores) {
        if (p > n) u += 1;
        else if (p === n) u += 0.5;
      }
    }
    const AUC = (g.pos_scores.length * g.neg_scores.length) > 0 ? u / (g.pos_scores.length * g.neg_scores.length) : 0;
    
    return { TPR, FPR, SR, BalAcc, AUC };
  };

  const priv = calcGroupMetrics(stats.Privileged);
  const disadv = calcGroupMetrics(stats.Disadvantaged);

  return {
    tpr_gap: Math.abs(priv.TPR - disadv.TPR),
    bal_acc_gap: Math.abs(priv.BalAcc - disadv.BalAcc),
    auc_gap: Math.abs(priv.AUC - disadv.AUC),
    sp_diff: Math.abs(priv.SR - disadv.SR),
    priv, disadv
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: render-metrics
renderMetrics = {
  const container = document.getElementById("eval-metrics-container");
  if (!container) return;
  
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="controls-card" style="padding: 1.5rem; margin-top: 1rem; width: 528px; box-sizing: border-box;">
      <h3 style="margin: 0 0 1rem 0; color: #cbd5e1;">PDF Fairness Metrics</h3>
      <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr; gap: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.95rem;">
        
        <div style="color: #94a3b8;">TPR Gap (Equality of Opportunity):</div>
        <div style="font-weight: 600; color: #fbbf24;">${(metrics.tpr_gap * 100).toFixed(1)}%</div>
        
        <div style="color: #94a3b8;">Balanced Accuracy Gap:</div>
        <div style="font-weight: 600; color: #fbbf24;">${(metrics.bal_acc_gap * 100).toFixed(1)}%</div>
        
        <div style="color: #94a3b8;">AUC Gap:</div>
        <div style="font-weight: 600; color: #fbbf24;">${(metrics.auc_gap * 100).toFixed(1)}%</div>
        
        <div style="color: #94a3b8;">Statistical Parity Diff (SR Gap):</div>
        <div style="font-weight: 600; color: #fbbf24;">${(metrics.sp_diff * 100).toFixed(1)}%</div>

        <div style="grid-column: 1 / -1; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); margin-top: 0.5rem; padding-top: 0.75rem;">
          <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.85rem;">
            <div>
              <strong style="color: #60a5fa">Privileged</strong><br/>
              TPR: ${(metrics.priv.TPR * 100).toFixed(1)}%<br/>
              BalAcc: ${(metrics.priv.BalAcc * 100).toFixed(1)}%<br/>
              AUC: ${(metrics.priv.AUC * 100).toFixed(1)}%<br/>
              SR: ${(metrics.priv.SR * 100).toFixed(1)}%
            </div>
            <div>
              <strong style="color: #f87171">Disadvantaged</strong><br/>
              TPR: ${(metrics.disadv.TPR * 100).toFixed(1)}%<br/>
              BalAcc: ${(metrics.disadv.BalAcc * 100).toFixed(1)}%<br/>
              AUC: ${(metrics.disadv.AUC * 100).toFixed(1)}%<br/>
              SR: ${(metrics.disadv.SR * 100).toFixed(1)}%
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}
```
